design: All13 H827 groups, identical recipients and block/random directions, central differences +/-0.1. Native trace included. Final-position traces after every downstream block plus attention RMS input/output and MLP raw/RMS input/output. Final norm, unembedding and softcap traced.
interpretation: Propagation localization, not module mediation or isolated Jacobian. Module responses see different context-dependent inputs; cosine drops do not quantify causal shares.
metric: Euclidean response cosines for internal vectors; uniform-centered and common-reference Fisher metric for logits. Every group uses its H827 mean native probability distribution.
